title: 和同事确认任务优先级
subtitle: Understanding requests and confirming what to do first

audio.title: A request from your boss
audio.note: 完整音频约 1分39秒；今天只听 0:00–1:15。已实际打开来源页，核验音频可播放、播放进度、时长及配套 Transcript。先不要展开原文；完整 Transcript 在来源页的 Transcript 标签中。

sections.title: 1. 无字幕听力｜先抓任务与顺序（4分钟）
sections.body:
打开来源页，只播放 0:00–1:15，先不要看 Preparation、Transcript 或下面的精听提示。

第一遍：不中断，只判断谁在提出请求、对方是否愿意帮忙。
第二遍：只记任务关键词，例如 customer、email、meeting、room，以及表示先后的 first、after that。听不清时继续，不要回头逐词翻译。
第三遍：完成两道主旨题，再估计第一次无字幕听懂比例。完成后才能进入精听。第三方原文只短提示一句：‘Can you send an email to the customer?’
questions: Susanne 请 Mario 首先做什么？A. 写项目报告 B. 给客户发邮件 C. 准备演示文稿
发送团队会议通知前，Mario 需要先做什么？A. 预订会议室 B. 打电话给经理 C. 打印报告
sections.answers:
1. B。第一项优先任务是给客户发邮件，询问下周访问时间。
2. A。他要先预订会议室，然后再给大家发邮件。

sections.title: 2. 精听辨音＋连读弱读（5分钟）
sections.body:
把 0:00–1:15 再听两遍。每处按“先听 → 暂停模仿两次 → 看提示 → 关文本重听”练习。

① Can you help me ...?｜Can you 常连得接近 /kənjə/，help、prepare 承担重音。
② What can I help you with?｜can 和 you 都较轻，help 与 with 更清楚；help_you 会自然连接。
③ I'll do it today.｜I'll 是 I will 的缩写，do_it 连读，重音落在 today。

最后关掉全部文字，重听 0:00–1:15 并跟读一轮。先模仿意群和重音，不要把每个词读得一样重。
questions: Can you 在自然语流中可能听起来接近什么？
I'll 是哪两个词的缩写？

sections.title: 3. 原创阅读｜先确认，再开始做（4分钟）
sections.body: On Monday morning, Nina's team leader gave her three tasks. She needed to update a customer list, book a room for Thursday's meeting and prepare two slides for a presentation. Nina understood the individual words, but she was not sure which task mattered most. Instead of silently starting the easiest one, she checked the order. She asked, “Should I update the customer list first?” Her team leader said yes because another colleague needed it before lunch. The meeting room was the second priority, while the slides could wait until Wednesday. Nina wrote the deadlines beside each task and repeated them aloud. At eleven thirty, she finished the list and sent a short message: “The customer list is ready. I'll book the meeting room next.” Her team leader replied with a thumbs-up. A thirty-second confirmation prevented several hours of work from being done in the wrong order.
questions: Why did Nina ask which task to do first?
What did she do after confirming the priorities?
sections.translation: 周一早上，妮娜的组长给了她三项任务：更新客户名单、为周四的会议预订房间，以及为演示准备两页幻灯片。妮娜听懂了每个词，却不确定哪项最重要。她没有默默地先做最简单的任务，而是确认顺序。她问：“我应该先更新客户名单吗？”组长说是，因为另一位同事午饭前就需要它。预订会议室是第二优先，幻灯片可以等到周三再做。妮娜把截止时间写在每项任务旁边，并大声复述。十一点半，她完成名单并发了一条简短消息：“客户名单已经准备好了。我接下来预订会议室。”组长回复了点赞。三十秒的确认避免了几个小时的工作被按错误顺序完成。
sections.answers:
1. She understood the tasks but was not sure which one was most important.
2. She wrote down the deadlines, repeated them and completed the customer list first.

sections.title: 4. 高频词块｜确认任务不绕弯（4分钟）
sections.body:
1. Can you help me with ...?｜你能帮我处理……吗？｜Can you help me with this report? 你能帮我处理这份报告吗？
2. What can I do to help?｜我能做什么来帮忙？｜You're busy. What can I do to help? 你很忙，我能帮什么？
3. Please do this first.｜请先做这件事。｜Please do this first; it's urgent. 请先做这件事，它很紧急。
4. It's a priority.｜这是优先事项。｜The customer email is a priority. 客户邮件是优先事项。
5. I'll do it today.｜我今天会完成。｜I'll do it today and update you. 我今天完成并向你汇报。
6. After that, ...｜之后……｜After that, I'll book the room. 之后我会预订房间。
7. There's no hurry.｜不用着急。｜There's no hurry; Friday is fine. 不用着急，周五完成就行。
8. urgent｜紧急的｜This request is urgent. 这个请求很紧急。
9. deadline｜截止时间｜What's the deadline for the report? 这份报告的截止时间是什么时候？
sections.answers: 优先记住 7 个词块：Can you help me with ...? / What can I do to help? / Please do this first. / It's a priority. / I'll do it today. / After that, ... / There's no hurry.

sections.title: 5. 语法｜first / after that / finally 表顺序（3分钟）
sections.body:
用 first、after that 和 finally 把任务顺序说清楚。它们常放在句首，后面接完整句子；finally 表示最后一步。

例句 1：First, book a meeting room. 首先，预订会议室。
例句 2：After that, send everyone an email. 之后，给所有人发邮件。
questions: 排序填空：___, check the customer list. After that, send the email.
用 finally 完成句子：Book the room, invite the team, and ___.
sections.answers:
1. First
2. Finally, write the short report.

sections.title: 6. 对话＋替换＋快速回应（3分钟）
sections.body:
原创对话
Manager: Can you help me with two things this morning?
Colleague: Sure. What should I do first?
Manager: First, please update the customer list. It's a priority.
Colleague: OK. What's the deadline?
Manager: Before eleven. After that, please book a meeting room.
Colleague: Got it. I'll update you when they're done.

替换练习
① customer list → sales report；before eleven → before lunch。
② book a meeting room → call the supplier；this morning → this afternoon。

快速回应：3 秒内开口。
1) 同事问你能否帮忙：Sure. What can I do to help?
2) 你想确认第一优先级：What should I do first?
3) 对方说任务不急：OK, thanks. When would you like it?

30–60 秒口头任务：复述三项工作安排。说明先做什么、截止时间、下一步和最后一步，并用一个问题确认优先级。不要先逐句翻译中文。
sections.answers: 示例：First, I'll send the customer email before lunch. After that, I'll book the meeting room. Finally, I'll start the short report. Is the customer email the top priority?

sections.title: 7. 前课复习＋反馈（1分钟）
sections.body:
复习昨天 3 个问路词块：
1. Excuse me.｜打扰一下。
2. How do I get to ...?｜我怎么去……？
3. It's next to ...｜它在……旁边。

快速串联：Excuse me. How do I get to the station? Is it next to the bank?

请回原聊天告诉我：① 今天第一次无字幕听懂了约百分之多少；② 最卡的是哪一句；③ 用英文文字或语音完成任务复述。只有实际收到并分析你的语音后，我才会评价发音。
sections.answers: 完成标准：能不看文字说出 3 个任务词块，并在 30–60 秒内讲清三项任务的先后顺序和截止时间。
